full_prompt_en: A square whimsical architectural illustration combines the profile of a top-hatted man with a tall narrow city building. A pale blue sky with small cream clouds fills the upper background. Near the center-left, the man's head faces left; his long triangular nose and simple dark eye are drawn with spare lines. A gray-blue top hat with a warm brown band rises above his head. The back of his face joins directly to an old masonry facade on the right, so windows, rooflines, and a slim chimney become part of the same vertical figure. The building has stacked window openings, a pale central doorway, and lightly worn cream-gray walls. A little smoke lifts from the chimney into the open sky. At the base, the man's blue-gray coat slopes down behind a low garden wall, while a small wooden gate sits before the building's entry. Two slender trees flank the structure, and a tiny person stands near the right side of the wall. The foreground pavement is nearly empty, allowing the odd hybrid silhouette to read immediately. Watercolor-like washes fill the sky, coat, and masonry, while thin precise ink lines pick out facial features, windows, railings, and branches. The palette stays gentle: dusty blue, warm cream, muted brown, olive green, and a little ochre. Even daylight from the upper left keeps shadows soft and shallow, with slightly darker values under the hat brim and behind the wall. The overall composition is playful and orderly, turning a quiet street elevation into one improbable but coherent upright character.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形奇趣建筑插画，将戴高帽男子的侧脸与一座高而窄的城市建筑结合。浅蓝天空里散着小片奶油色云。中央偏左，男子的头朝左，细长三角鼻与简洁深色眼睛由节省的线条画出。一顶灰蓝高帽带暖棕帽带，从头顶升起。侧脸后部直接与右方旧石砌立面连接，窗、屋顶线和细烟囱都成为同一个竖向人物的一部分。建筑有层叠窗洞、浅色中央门洞和略带磨损的奶油灰墙。少量烟从烟囱升入开阔天空。底部，男子的蓝灰大衣斜向低矮花园墙后，建筑入口前有一扇小木门。两棵细树从两侧框住结构，墙右边附近站着一个极小的人。前景铺地几乎空白，让奇特的混合剪影立即可读。水彩般晕染填入天空、衣服和石材，纤细精确墨线则点出面部、窗、栏杆与枝条。色盘温和：灰蓝、暖奶油、低调棕、橄榄绿与少量赭色。来自左上方的均匀日光使阴影柔和而浅，只在帽檐下和墙后有稍深明度。整体构图俏皮而有序，把安静街道立面变成一位不可能却自洽的直立角色。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines delicate architectural draftsmanship with whimsical visual substitution and pale watercolor washes. Thin ink contours define precise stacked geometry, while soft blue, cream, muted brown, and olive areas keep the surface light and approachable. A prominent upright hybrid silhouette can join unlike shapes through shared edges and aligned proportions. Small windows, rails, and branches supply fine detail around larger quiet planes. Paper grain and gently uneven pigment make the image tactile without heavy texture. Daylight is clear and even, with only modest under-edge shadows and little dramatic modeling. The composition is sparse, balanced, and quietly absurd, letting the central formal idea remain immediately legible.
style_prompt_zh: 插画将精巧建筑制图与奇趣的视觉替代、浅淡水彩晕染结合。细墨轮廓界定精确层叠几何形，柔蓝、奶油、低调棕和橄榄色域使表面轻盈亲切。突出的竖向混合剪影可以通过共同边界和对齐比例连接不同形状。小窗、栏杆与枝条为较大安静平面周围提供精细细节。纸纹和轻微不均的颜料让图像可触，却没有沉重肌理。日光清亮而均匀，只有适度下缘阴影，戏剧性塑形很少。构图稀疏、平衡，安静而荒诞，让中央形式想法立即可读。
theme_en: A top-hatted man's profile fused with a narrow city building
theme_zh: 戴高帽男子的侧脸与狭窄城市建筑融为一体
name: Saul Steinberg
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
